verdict.rationale: The evidence shows rules that apply automatically to all matching payments, value lists that group values, and a review queue for targeted examination. None of these is a documented bulk-action capability. The reviews API is per-item (POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve), and no batch endpoint or multi-select action across many items is evidenced. Rule-based automation and list grouping are adjacent features, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
